༄༅/zhi khro bder bshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad khro bo rol pa'i gtor sgrub chen mo'i phyag bzhes kyi zin ris bzhugs so/160)na mo gu ru sa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ zhi khro bder bshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad khro bo rol pa'i gtor sgrub chen mo'i phyag bzhes kyi zin ris bzhugs so/ 160) na mo gu ru sa mā dā na ye/ ye shes sgyu ma stong nyid rol pa las// log rtog sgyu ma'i dgra gegs 'dul slad du// thugs rje sgyu ma lta bu'i gar mkhan mchog /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lhar bcas mchod// gsang sngags rgyud sde ma lus kun gyi snying*// bder gshegs 'dus pa bka' brgyad kyi// gtor sgrub chen mo'i las rim khrigs chags su// sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor dang yo byad bshams bkod kyi tshul ji ltar bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi las rim mthar chags kyi tshul rnams bya ba'i thabs dang*/ rjes kyi las sbyor phrin las kha bsgyur drag las kyi rim pa'i tshul rnams ston pa dang gsum las dang po sngon 'gro ni/ de yang 'di lta bu byed pa'i gang zag des sngon nas sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi chos bka' yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang lung legs par thob cing bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'am/ tha ma yang dbang bsdus pa gang rung dang 'di skabs kyi chog gzhung rnams kyi lung thob pa dang*/ yi dam gang rung zhig la bsnyen tshad them 162) pa tsam zhig ni med mi rung ba de ltar sngon du sgrub par byas la/ ༈ de nas 'di nyid gang du byas pa'i gnas der dgos pa'i yo byad dang 'khor lo liṅga rdzas kyi bye brag sogs thams cad snga tshags su chud par byas nas/ dus tshes la nam babs pa'i skabs der/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu rgya khyon mtho dgu las mi chung ba'i khar/ sba phub kyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ de yang bka' brgyad nyid kyi dbang sgrub chen mo dang 'brel ba'i skabs lta bu yin na ni/ dkyil 'khor chen mo'i mdun sogs gang 'thad du 'di nyid las kyi dkyil 'khor du bya zhing*/ de lta bu dang ma 'brel bar 'di kho na chod gtad du bsgrub pa yin na/

thig chog dang tshon byin rlabs sogs kyang sgrub khog ltar grub na legs shing*/ dkyil 'khor ni lte ba chos 'byung bsnol ma lhum̐ mthing gis mtshan pa'i phyi rim 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad 163)la hūm̐ brgyad rnams gtso bo so so'i sku mdog mthun pa bris pa'i mtha' skor thod ra rdor pad me ris bskor zhing*/ phyi rol nas ma traṃ gi gzugs mgo lho nub tu bstan pa spyi dang mtshungs par bri/ de'i steng du lding khri dngos sam ma 'dzoms na hoṃ bsnol mda' gang tsam bsra zhing brtan pa'i khar sba phub che ba zhig bzhag pa'i steng du g.yang gzhi sogs kyi gdan la dbus su tshom bu dgu dang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du lnga tshom re dgod/ de nas gtor ma rnams bzhengs grub nas ma bsham tsam gyi bar der rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du lcags slang sogs kyi nang du gdan 'khor lo liṅga lto 'khor rnams bshams te bsangs sbyangs shing*/ mkhyen gsol gzu dpang rgyas bsdus gang 'os byas la bdain stobs dgug gzhug drag po bdun nam gsum sogs kyis bkug bstim nan tan du byas nas go rim 164) ma nor bar bkod pa ni gal che ba'i gnad cig go 'khor lo sogs de dag gi bri tshul ni gzhung dpe ris phyag len sogs las byung ba ltar te/ gtso gtor gyi 'og tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rtse mo nang bstan dang*/ 'khor lo rnams la rtsibs drug pa ste mdor na dpe'u chung ltar bris pa'i liṅga'i 'phong phyir bstan nas so so'i tshom bu'i khar bkram la/ de dag steng du gsad 'khor rnams kha mar bstan la bkab pa'i khar gdan 'khor rnams kha yar bstan nas bting ba'i steng du gtor chen rnams dgod par bya'o/ gtor ma ni gzhung las dreg pa spyi bzlog gtor ma mdos su gtong ba'i dgongs pa ltar gyi dbang du byas na/ sna phub de ka'i steng du gtor chen dgu po shong ba'i chag tshad dang bstun pa'i gtor snod la/

dbus su che mchog gi gtor ma gtso 'khor dgu pa mtheb kyus brgyan pa la/ 165) mar khru gang pa bco brgyad la drag sngags drag sngags kyi shog byang gi brgyan pa gzug cing*/ lte bar gtor khung btod la lto 'khor phyag bzhes ltar ltebs pa

gro ga'i lpags pa gtsang ma sogs rlan gyis mi 'jig pa/ sa'i dril tshas dang ldan par gzhug gtso gtor gyi khyung gi lto bar lto 'khor che chung dang*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi 'khor lnga*/ gzhan yang 'debs kha'i lto byang sogs dgos ched rgyas bsdus gang 'os skabs dang mthun par rlan gyis mi 'jig par byas te gzhug cing*/ byang bu lnga pa ltar gyi pho shing mo shing gi byang bu rnams dang*/ khyung bcas nas gsungs pa'i sngags byang rnams dang bcas pa rnams rdzogs par dag g.yas g.yon du rtsangs ring sngags byang can gnyis dang*/ steng nas sbrul ma'i 'khor lo 'di ni gtor ma mdos su gtong ba'i lugs ltar yin la/ gzhan skabs dang sbyar rung ngo*/ nam mkha'i tog dang ldan 166) pa rtsibs brgyad pa byas la bsrung 'khor kha bstan pa dang zlog 'khor steng nas yar kha bstan pa byas pa'i rtsibs brgyad la phyogs mtshams kyi rgyal mtshan tshar gnyis 'dzom na 'di ltar bya ba yin no/ brgyad dang*/ nam mkha'i tog la gtso bo nyid kyi rgyal mtshan btags par bya zhing*/ de bzhin du gtso bo brgyad pa'i gtor snod rnams rgyab phyogs kyi zur gnyis bcag nas gru gsum du byas na sba phub khar bkod bde ba'i khyad yod cing*/ dpal so so la 'khor bzhi bzhi dang mthims kyus brgyan pa/ rtsangs ring gnyis sngags byang dang bcas pa/ gong bzhin dang*/ steng nas snal ma'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa re la rang rang gi srung zlog gi 'khor lo dang so so'i rgyal mtshan bcas gzug khyung phran khyungs dgu ma yin tshe rnams kyi lte bar yang ltas ngan zlog pa'i 'khor lo re dang*/ byang bu lnga pa ltar gyi sngags byang gi brgyan pa bya zhing*/ so so'i gtor ma'i lte 'khor bzhugs tshul 167) rnams kyang gong bzhin byas la/ gtso bo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du zhal phyir gzigs su bkod/ rdul tshon dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba dang mtha' skor du phur pa dgu

mar me dgu zan ling dgu rnams bkram/ de'i mthar shar phyogs su zhi ba/ che mchog yang dag dang gsum gyi khram 'di rnams phyag bzhes lugs gcig yin cing*/ khro bzlog gi gzhung gyer rgyu kyang yod la/ ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ shing dang*/ phyogs mtshams gzhan rnams su gtso bo so so'i shing rnams gzug cing*/ de bzhin du brgya gsogs kyi dbang du byas na zor mda' brgya/ so sba phub dang mnyam pa bskor la gzug de'i phyi skor du zor kong brgya la byang bu brgya gsogs nas gsungs pa'i shing la sngags tshan gnyis gsum re bris pa dang rtsa thung gnyis re gtsug cing zor gzhung ltar gyi rdzas rnams blugs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ gtor zor/ khrag zor/ rdo zor rnams brgya rtse re bsdu na bdun lnga gsum gcig sogs byar rung ngo*/ 168) byas te bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub ma traṃ gi mgo'i steng du khams gsum hūm̐ sgra can gyi 'di gang yin pa go mkhan min 'dug kyang khyung rnams kyi gso gtor yin no gtor ma zur gsum gtso 'khor dgu ldan khyung dang gtso bo'i zhal 'bag sogs bris pa gtsug cing*/ rtsangs dang sngags byang sogs gtso gtor dang mthun pa byas la bshams/ mdun mdun byang du bzhag na 'thad par snang phyogs su sde dpon sum cu dang*/ dpal 'di mdun phyogs su 'thad kyang ji ltar rigs pa so so'i bris sku dang dar gyi cod pan rgyal mtshan sogs kyis mdzes shing rngams brjid dang ldan par bkod khyad par sgrub chen dkyil 'khor dang mi 'brel na/ rgyab phyogs sam gang 'os su stegs mtho bar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma dang sman rag mchod rdzas rgya chen po dang*/ tshe dang dngos grub blang ba'i yo byad 169) rnams kyang tshul bzhin bshams pa yang gal po che'i gnad rjes mtha' rgyas kyi las rim rnams 'di la brten dgos pa'i phyir ro/ yin cing*/ gzhan yang*/ 'di nyid kyi las sbyor kha bsgyur gang byed kyi gca' gzhi'i bye brag srin mo za lam dang*/

ltas ngan dmigs sgral/ rnga mo khyung zhon/ 'debs kha/ las phran/ kha bsgyur sogs tha dad kyi rigs gang la gang dgos rnams rnams kyang gzhung dang phyag bzhes mthong rgyud ltar bsags shing bsham/ bsgral las sogs la dgos pa'i yo byad kun dang phyag mtshan g.yab dar phur thun mtshon dgu la sogs mtha' dag kyang tshags su tshud cing 'dzom par bya ba ste/ lar yang 'di ni bder gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs ma lus pa'i bsnyen sgrub chen mo gtor ma la brten pa yin pas na/ gnas dang gang zag gis khyab na phyi nang mtshams gcod rgyal tho sgo byang 170) mtshams phur gdags pa dam sri mnan pa sogs dang*/ nang du dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod bshar gdab mnga' gsol sogs mdor na sgrub chen khog 'bub kyi gzhung tshul bzhin bsrang dgos pa yin gyi/ deng sang ni khro bo rol pa'i gtor zlog ces kun rdzob ltar gyi sngags bon phal pa'i yas btags dkyus ma dang 'dra bar brtsi zhing*/ gang zag kyang su yin yin gyis byed/ yul dang sbyin bdag kyang rung rung la byed/ yo byad dang phyag len yang ci byung byung gis chog par byed pa 'di lta bu la ni gsang sngags dmar bshas su byed pa ces gsungs te/ byin rlabs dang nus pa ni phar zhog mkha' 'gro bka' srung sogs mi mnyes pa'i mkhu ldog 'byung bar bshad cing*/ byed pa po la yang gsang sngags gsang sgrog gi ltung ba dang gzu lum ras chod kyi nyes pa tshad med pa 'byung bar gsungs la/ 'on te spros pa med 171) pa'i don 'ba' zhig mngon du gyur pa zhig la ni 'di dag gi bya ba brtsams par yang mi 'tshal la/ de lta bu mngon du ma gyur ba'i gang zag gis ni gzhung dang slob dpon gyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba la tshul bzhin 'bad dgos kyi/ sla chos dag sgyid ngan gyi dbang du btang nas spros med la khag bkal ba'i brtsing chos kyis rgyal ba'i bka' gzhung gi khyad du gsad pas ni don 'grub par mi 'gyur bas/

de lta bu dgongs don rtogs dgos par gda' ba ni phyi rabs kyi gang zag blo ldan rnams kyi yid la bcag 'tshal/ ༈ don gnyis pa cho ga dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gzhung srong gi rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ de lta bu'i sngon 'gro bshams bkod kyi las rim thams cad tshul ldan du legs par grub nas/ thog mar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa dang*/ 172) sngon gtor bgegs skrad mtshams spyod bsrung 'khor mchod rdzas byin rlabs sogs kyi las rim mtha' dag las gzhung che chung gang byed kyi gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin rgyas par bya zhing*/ bdag bskyed rdzogs che 'bring chung ngu gang byed kyi spyan 'dren yan dang*/ de nas mdun bskyed mngon rtogs 'od kyi dra ba sogs rgyas bsdus gang yin bsgom la/ bdag mdun zung 'jug ji ltar rigs pa dang sde dpon sum cu'i mchod gtor sogs kyang bya zhing*/ de yang mi lag gis khyab na/ la las sngags kyi bzlas rgyun 'ba' zhig bzung zhing*/ la las cho ga gzhung srong dang bskang rgyun bzung ba sogs mdor na sgrub chen gyi skabs ltar bya zhing*/ mi lag gis 173) ma lcogs na cho ga dang bzlas pa dang spel mar bya ba nyid las 'os med de/ gang ltar yang 'dzab kyi thun mtshams rnams su stong tshig gi mchod bstod bya bar gsungs phyir/ mchod pa bsdus pa re dang bzhi bstod dang nyis bstod sogs gang 'os skabs dang bstun te bya zhing*/ tshogs kyi skabs su dam rdzas mdangs kyi bskang ba dang mchod bstod bshags pa'i bskang ba yang bya ba dang*/ nyin mtshan thun mtshams rnams la gdab las don drug pa yan chad kyang spyi ltar bya'o/ ༈ khyad par bsnyen sgrub kyi zhag grangs ji tsam bya ba'i nub dang por bder gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyi 'dzab bskul 'dzab dgongs sogs dang bcas te zhi bsnyen 'di'i rgyud las zhi bar bsnyen cing khro bor bsgrub ces gsungs pa ltar gyis/ zhag dang po 'di bsnyen la/

de lhag ma rnams sgrub pa yin pa dang*/ phyi ma'i nub mo man chad las sbyor yin no/ de bzhin du nub gnyis pa la gtso bo che mchog nub gsum par dpal brgyad po rnams dang*/ bzhi par khyung chen rigs lnga'i bsnyen pa khyung gi las sngags la 'bad/ de lhag zhag rnams bka' brgyad spyi dril drag sngags so lnga pa bzla zhing*/ nub rting la las 'grig chen mo tshar ba'i nub mo/ ma zor gyi las dgu sogs nas 'byung ba'i zor gyi ngar 'dogs pa'i las sngags rnams dang*/ gzhan yang zur gsog gi rigs sogs las sbyor gyi drag sngags gang la gang 'dod kyi bzlas pa rnams bya la/ gal te cis kyang mi grangs dang zhag grangs long khyab sogs kyis ma 'byor na drag sgrub zhag thamasacad sngags so lnga pa kho na la 'bungs kyang rung ngo*/ gzhan bar mtshams rnams su thun la brten nas gsad pa'i sngags dang*/ liṅga bla 'gugs kyi sngags sogs kyang gang 'gab skabs sbyor shes par bya ste/ mdor na 'di yan chad sgrub pa dngos 175) gzhi'i las rim yin pas zhag grangs dgu bdun lnga sogs ji ltar rigs pa'am/ gal che na dngos nyams rmi lam gyi rtags thon du bsgrub par bya'o/ ༈ de nas las sbyor gyi skabs la babs pa'i nyi ma 'di skabs ding sang phal cher las 'grig dang gtor ma 'phang ba gnyis nyin gcig la byed pa mang yang*/ de ltar na ha cang ring stabs su gyur te phyag len smin so mi 'byung bas/ nyi ma snga rting byed pa phyag bzhes legs so/ bskang ba'i rigs rnams dang*/ khyad par tshogs nya bsgral ba'i mthar bam skong yang 'dir bya ba phyag srol yang na bsgral las tshar ba'i ling ro bstab pa dang lhan cig bya ba'i gang 'thad bya/ dang srung ma'i rigs kyi bskang ba dang*/ tshogs lhag yan chad grub par byas pa'i rjes su de nas bsgral las chen mo la/ 176) dgos pa'i ling chen yang sta gon byas la/ nyin gung gi thun la gdab las rgyas pa byed rgyu'i snga gro nas las 'grig gi thog mar lha tshogs rnams la bstod pa mnga' gsol ba rgyas par bya zhing*/

de nas drag po'i phrin las bskul phyir rgyal ba spyi bskul chen mo dang*/ dam can dgos bskul/ pho nya dgos bskul dang bcas pa rnams kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul/ gser skyems kyi mchod rdzas bsangs dud sogs kyi yo byad dang ldan pas mchod pa phud skongs chen mo dang*/ dam bdar bcos bskul rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ de nas slob dpon gyi mdun du bsgral las kyi bca' gzhi bsham khyung bcas nas oṃ badzra maṇḍa la hūm̐ ces sogs 'byung ba'i snod bcud lhar gsal ba de dag dmag dpung go gsar pa ltar bskyed cing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs kyi gzu dpang gi /bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin byed pa'i don ma chung*// zhes pa'i mthar khyung bcas 177) kyi gzhung nas 'byung ba'i/ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa ces sogs nas/ 'dul ba'i las mdzod cig ces pa'i bar dang*/ slar bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi don ma chung*/ zhes sogs kyis mkhyen gsol gzu dpang rgyas par bya/ de nas bdag dpal chen por gsal ba/ liṅga dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba phur pa gras mchog tu gsal ba dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ bdag nyid gdab las nas 'byung ba ltar gyis nyid dpal du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas e gcig 'phros pa las/ ces sogs kyi hom khung bskyed la/ de'i nang du liṅga dgra bgegs dngos su bskyed pa tshig don mthun par byas nas/ bden stobs kyis dgug gzhug drag po lan mang du byas pas bkug pa'i mthar/ gdab las kyi smug nag gru gsum nyra sogs tshig rkang brgyad kyis che mchog lha tshogs rnams bskul zhing*/ slar dam khyung bcas nas 'byung ba'i tshig chen po dang*/ khrag 'thung sku las sprul pa'i sogs dang*/ gdab las kyi nam mkha' 178) mthongs su shor mi srid// sogs kyi 'phyong rnams gdag pa'i mjug tu/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī sogs dang*/ ho/ dpal chen po che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs// ces pa nas khug cig gyi bar gyi dmod pa rnams brjod de/

'di bzhin dpal brgyad ka la 'gro'o/ ༈ de nas yang*/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i sogs kyis yang dag lha tshogs rnams bskul zhing*/ e yi tshogs khyung bcas nas kyi sogs dang*/ lha mo blo ldan nas/ rdul du rlog ces pa'i bar gyi 'phyong gdag cing*/ ru lu'i sngags dang*/ hoḥ dpal chen po yang dag thugs kyi sogs nas/ rlag par gyis shig bar gyi dmod pa brjod de/ de nas yang*/ ser nag gru gsum sogs rkang pa brgyad kyi 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs bskul zhing*/ de'i 'phyong du/ khyung bcas nas dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can la// 'go bar byed pa'i lha khyod nyon// zhes sogs nas/ ma mdzad cig ces pa'i bar dang*/ gdab las so sor ma yi 179) pang du blang tsa na/ sogs mthar chags dang*/ a kro'i sngags dang dmod pa yang brjod cing rdzas sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas lha bye bya'o/ de nas rta mgrin/ phur pa/ ma mo dang bcas pa rnams la 'phyong gzhan med pas rang rang gi bskul dang*/ sngags dang*/ dmod pa rnams mthar chags gdab las ltar bya ba nyid do/ de nas bsgral las kyi dang po nyes pa bsgrags pa ni/ sems can chen po khyod nyon cig /zhes pa nas/ bsgral bar bya/ zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ skabs 'dir phur pa sras mchog tu gsal ba ni/ bdag gi lag pa g.yas kyi soro mo lnga la zhes sogs kyi gsal gdab la/ sgrol nus pa'i dbang thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlab cing*/ slar yang bdag nyid che mchog ces sogs nas/ smos ci dgos/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bdag khyung bcas nas nyid khrag 'thung he ru ka nas/ bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar gyi phur pa mnga' gsol zhing gzi byin bskyed/ 'di skabs su phur pa ye shes kyi lha la btab pa dang snod bcud la btab pa la sogs rnams ni khro bo rol pa'i gzhung 'di dkyus las mi gsal bas rgyas brda tsam khyung bcas nas brjod kyang par spro na slob dpon mchog kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/

de nas tshe khrus gyi dgongs pas bdag nyid nus stobs bskyed cing dmigs bya'i las ngan gyi bag chags sbyang bar bya ste/ khyung bcas nas e ma khams gsum sems can rnams ces sogs dang*/ pho'i ༈ 'di ni bder 'dus nyid kyi dkyus ltar yin kyang*/ ding sang ni gnas go drug pas mdzad pa'i gdab las gdug pa kun sgrol ltar byed pa mang zhing stabs kyang de ka bde bar snang ngo*/ snying gi dkyil du zhes sogs nas mthar chags su bya zhing*/ khyung bcas nas lcags sam nag po'i shing sogs nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa sogs kyi bar 181) byas pa'i mjug tu gdab pa don snying nas 'byung ba'i lcags sam gdug pa'i sogs nas/ lha klu byad kha zlog sogs dang*/ yon tan rgyud nas 'byang ba yi// sogs kyi phur zlog kyang bya zhing*/ de'i rjes su khraṃ shing dang mda' nag po 'thogs te/ da ni kha skong nas sngags 'chang sogs kyi mthar/ byad ma'i thog te bhyoḥsogs kyis bhyo 'debs bya zhing slar/ kha skang nas 'byung che mchog lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams// ces sogs kyi bcol gdams kyang bya'o/ de nas bsgral ba dngos la dang por/ mthing nag gru gsum sogs kyi tshig rkang brgyad kyis mchod bstod lha tshogs bskul la/ chos kyi dbyigs rang byung sogs tshig rkang bzhi dang*/

lag len chen mo nas che mchog badzra ki la ya// tses sogs dang*/ kha skong nas 'byung dug lnga 'dus pa'i ces pa nas/ nga la ltos ces pa'i bar dang*/ nga lag len las ni bka' brgyad he ru ka/ sogs dang*/ kha bcas nas nga ni dus gsum sogs nas 182) ma ra ya dza dza'i bar brjod pa'i rjes su phur thun mtshon dgu rnams kyis bsgral te/ gdab las nas rdo rje phur pa kī la ya/ sogs mthar chags bya/ de nas khyung bcas nas rdung gcig rdo rje 'bar ba sogs nas/ kha thaṃ gyi bar brjod pa gtun rung dang*/ slar yang kha skong nas bka' brgyad sprul pa'i bshan pa 'bum zhes sogs brjod pas mtshon chas btub cing bsgral/ drag po'i thun gyis gsad pa yang skabs 'dir bya zhing*/ de nas oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba sogs mchod bstod kyi sngags dang dmod pa rnams bya'o/ de nas bstab pa'i las rim rnams kyi thog mar/ mthing nag glegs bam sogs rkang pa brgyad kyis drag sngags lha tshogs bskul zhing*/ phye cig phye cig zhal phye cig sogs dang*/ lag len las chos sku skye maid rang bzhin las/ ces sogs kyi stab cing*/ zlog 'bum rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis mi sha khrag mchod bya zhing phrin las gzhol/ oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭan sogs dmod pa drag 183) sngags kyi sngags dang dmod mo byas la/ slar yang lha tshogs rnams la bsgral las kyi dpa' yon lta bu'am gtang rag gi phyir du dmar sbreng*/ slar stabs/ mchod pa/ bstod pa dang bzhi las dang po dmar chen khrag gi mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ nga rgyal khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil li kha skong gi smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas li// sogs dpal dgu so so'i gcig dril gang rung dmod skabs dang bstun te bya/ slar stab ni gong gi ling ro lhag ma bran zhing*/ kha skong nas bder gshegs zhi khro lha tshogs rnams// ces pa nas/ sa ma ya kha hi'i bar gyis 'bul zhing bam skong yang gong du ma byas na skabs 'dir bya'o/

'dir dkyil 'khor du 'bul ba la mi dbang ba'i rigs kyi srung ma dag la sha khrag gi lhag ma cung zad phyi rol du gtor zhing bsngo bar bya ba yang phyag bzhes so/ mchod pa ni/ gtor ma kha 184) gso zhing sman rag sbreng la/ kha skong las 'jig rten gtor snod bcud rnams gtor mar sbyar// sogs kyis mchod la/ bka' brgyad kyis bstod pa rgyas bsdus long skabs dang sbyar ba'i gtang rag bstod bya'o/ mthar bdag dang lha'i mthuo stobs gzi byin gso ba dang*/ gzas pa po'i khams bco brgyad kyi sgrib pa sbyang nas rgyal ba'i sras su bya ba/ snod bcud thams cad dpal gyi skur bsdu zhing dbyings su 'khor gsum yongs dag chen po'i rgyas gdab pa rnams ni 'di skabs gcig pur ma zad bsgral las byed do cog thams cad kyi mjug don yang dag pa'i snying po yin phyir/ tshul 'di dag gi phyag bzhes la 'khyel 'tshal lo/ ༈ de ltar gtor sgrub chen mo'i bsnyen sgrub dang las 'grig dngos gzhi'i rim pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par grub nas/ mthar mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyis las kyi 185) mjug bsdu ba ni gsang sngags spyi 'gros yin mod kyi/ de las mnan pa'i las mtha' khyad par ba ni skabs dkyus kyi khrigs rim la dgos shas chung bas 'dir re shig sreg 'phang gnyis kyi bya tshul 'chad par bya ste/ de yang gong du brjod pa bzhin sgrub pa'i zhag grangs ji tsam byed pa'i zhag phyi ma'i dang po bsgral las dngos byas/ de'i nub mo zor sngags sogs bzla/ nang par tho rangs nas las gzhung bskang gso tshogs mchod sogs rgyas par grub rjes/ bka' brgyad nyid kyi sbyin sreg rgyas pa bya ba'am/ yang phrin las kyi gzer chen lnga'i nang tshan kyi hom la brten nas bsreg pa'i las sbyor tshul ldan byed na mchog mod kyi/ de lta bu ma grub pa'i tshe na/ lcags slang gi nang du skyer pa'i shing sogs kyi me thab chung ngu

186) bcas la/ me lha drag g.yo'i lugs kyi skye mchog dang de'i lto bar bkab brgyad kyi lha tshogs tshang bar bskyed nas/ spyan 'dren mchod pa mdor bsdus bya zhoing*/ las sbyor gyi 'khor lo dang liṅga bsreg par 'os pa thams cad dang*/ gdab las kyi ling ro sha khag sogs dang*/ gzhan yang sreg rdzas kyi tshogs kyang gang 'byor 'bul zhing*/ bstod pa dang phrin las bcol ba la gshegs gsol bya/ de'i me ro yangagator zor 'phang ba'i dus lhan cig tu 'khyer la zoradu 'phen/ yang na thal ba cha gcig mnan pa byas kyang rung bas ji ltar rigs pa skabs kyi dgos don dang bstun la bya'o/ ༈ de nas lha tshogs rnams la dpa' bo g.yul du chas pa'i dmag gi go sar ba'i brda' gtong ba'i tshul du drag las kyi bca' ka dang gshom ra chos skyong gi ru dar sogs thams cad sta gon du byas la/ thog mar 187) gser skyems phul zhing*/ rig 'dzin spyi bskul/ 'di dag da lta'i khro rol dkyus ma'i dpe la med pa shas che yang bder 'dus nyid las 'byung ngo*/ dam can spyi bskul chos skyong so so'i dgos bskul rnams dang*/ gzer kha'i 'phyong smad las bskul gyi byang bu/ khyung gi las byang chen mo'i bskul sogs khyung bskal rgyas bsdus bya lung rgya mtsho la sogs pa bskul gyi rigs thams cad byas la/ bar 'dir las phran bcu dang*/ 'debs ka dgu/ kha bsgyur bcu drug sogs kha tshar gyi las sbyor dgos pa'i rigs yod na bya zhing gtor zlog rkyang pa la ni de dag mi dgos pas dbye mtshams shes par bya'o/ de nas zlog gzhung rnams kyi dang por/ phy-i'i gtor mas 'khor ba myang 'das su bzlog pa dang*/ nang gi gtor mas sems can sangs rgyas su bzlog pa dang*/ gsang ba'i gtor mas dug lnga ye shes lngar bzlog pa dang bcas 188) pa rnams dang*/ de nas gtor ma la brten nas bzlog pa'i zer kha/ rgyal mtshan dgu 'chongs/

bhyo 'debs/ khraṃ bzlog rtsangs gyer sogs bya/ yang skag bsgyur ngar glud ltar gtong ba'i tshe na bar 'dir de'i gzhung yang gyer drag po'i sngags zlog chen mo ni snga phyi long skabs dang bstun pa'i ngos nas ji tsam grub pa bya zhing*/ khyung gi pra brtag kyang bya/ de nas gtor ma rnams dkyil 'khor dpe ris ltar rdul mtshon nam 'bru nag gi phye ma 'bri/ steng nas mdun du dpags te gtor dril bya/ zor sgo dbye zhing phyi rgyal tho sgo sogs yod na btang rag phul la dkrol ba sgrub chen ltar dang*/ rol tu sleb nas 'chad mdo'i gtor ma 'bul zhing 'chad rgyu zur du la 'bul zhing spung gtor chung ba gcig sngar nas sta gon byas nas 'di skabs su 'bul ba yang gtor ma 'phang 'das rims thams cad gal che bar gsungs so/ 'chad mdo gyer/ de rjes za laṃ dang dmigs bsgral so so'i zlog gzhung gyer la de gnyis 'phang*/ khyung zlog dgyer zhing khyung rnams gshegs/ de nas zor dngos kyi dang por gser skyems phul zhing zor lha nor 'dus nas zor 'phang ba'i byang bu nas 'byung bskul/ de nas zor gyi las dgu pa'i lugs dang bstun na de ltar dang*/ gzhan bder 'dus nyid kyi zor gzhung bzhin te/ dang po skong zor/ gnyis pa gtor zor/ gsum pa mda' zor/ bzhi pa rdo zor/ lnga pa khrag zor rnams gyer dang mthun par rim pa 'phang*/ 'dir ding sang phyag srol la lar zor rnams mtshams thams cad du 'phang bar byed pa snang kyang*/ 'di'i dgongs par ni/ gser skyems dang dkar gtor sogs phyogs bcur phul nas phyogs skyong sogs la ru nga ma byed par bka' bsgo ba yin mod kyi/ zor ni nges par dmigs sgo yod na de phyogs dang*/ med na gtor ma 'phang ba'i phyogs su 'phang dgos kyi/ gzhan phyogs 190) su 'phang na gza'i 'gyu phyogs dang sgra gcan sogs brtsi ba la dgos pa med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ de nas bzhes 'bod sogs byas la/

gtor ma'i ye shes pa gshegs shing dug mtshon dmag dpung sogs dmigs pa kha bsgyur nas dgra phyogs su 'phang zhing drag sngags dmod bcol rdul rlog sogs bya/ gtor gzhing bshal chus bstan ma skyong ba dang*/ gtor mnan sogs dang phyi rjes kyi mtshams gcod dang go bgo ba sogs bya zhing*/ nang du log nas tshe'i cho ga dngos grub blang ba/ mar me'i smon lam sogs dang*/ bshags pa bsngo smon bkra shis sogs rjes mtha' rgyas kyi las rim rnams ni sgrub chen dang 'brel na de'i dkyus bzhin dang*/ mi 'brel na yang spyi dang mthun par zhib rgyas su bya ste/ mjug gi las rim 'di la sla chos byar mi rung ste/ yon mchod dang gnas yul sogs la bkra mi shis 191) kyi rten 'brel gnad che bar gsungs pas so/ e ma/ gsang sngags rgyud sde'i snying po yang*// bder gshegs kun 'dus sgrub pa pa bka' brgyad la/ bsnyen cing bsgrub pas dngos grub mchog brnyes pa/ rgya bod rig 'dzin grangs mang byon mod kyang*// ding sang snyigs ma'i yang snying 'di 'dra'i tshe// bka' brgyad smin grol bang mdzod ma thob par// khro rol bu smad gso ba'i yas mchog tu// byed pa'i sngags 'chang khas 'ches grong sgo khengs// kye ma gsang sngags 'di 'chi khar cir 'gyur soms/ gsang sngags chos la bslab pa'i mtha' bcu dgos/ bka' brgyad mkhan la bskyed rdzogs gung dgu 192) dgos/ gdab las byed na rdzong 'phrang srog gsum dgos/ dgos kyang yod mkhan dkon par gzigs lags sam/ ༈ bskyed rdzogs dgongs don cha tsam ma rtogs bzhin// srung bzlog las gzhung bon ltar gyer ba des// lto tsam phyis kyang gsang sngags dmar bshas kyi// rnam par smin des phyi ma cir skye soms/ ༈ zol zog rdzun lam 'khyog pos dgu rnams la// bden gtam drang ba'i lam srol bstan na yang*// rlung nad can la ga bur blud ltar bas// lce rtse nang du bkug pa gnad du zab//

༈ de lta'ang bka' drin mtshungs med rje// dpal ldan gzhan phan rdo rje dang*// rgyas sras rig 'dzin snying po sogs// zhal gdams las byung tshul 'di bris// ༈ rang nyid sgom chen rgan po la// 'di 'dra'i tshul gyis ci zhig bya// 'on kyang phyi rabs sngags chung 'gar// phan snyam bsam pa dkar de'i 193) dge / ༈ 'di dang dus gsum dge tshogs kun// gcig bsdoms gsang sngags 'bras bu'i theg 'dzin skyong bsrung dang spel ba'i rgyur// bsngo dang smon pa 'grub gyur cig ces spong ba'i brtul zhugs la mos pa lam du byed pa sna tshogs rang grol gyi bkod pa 'jug pa'i sgo ni dbang gis phye ba/ gzhi dang srog ni dam tshig gis bzung ba/ thag ni lta bas bcad pa/ la ni spyod pas dor ba/ nyams su ni ting 'dzin gyis blang ba/ don ni man ngag zab mo sgrubs pa/ rgyud ni thos pas grol ba/ sgo ni theg pa kun nas 'dur ba/ shes bya ni phyogs med la bslab pa/ dgongs don ni du ma ro gcig tu bsdu ba ste/ de ltar bslab par bya'o/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi dung shing dgu ni/ sku 'jam dpal 'chi med kyi dgongs pa 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi/ gsung padma rnam dag gi dgongs pa rta skad 194) theng gsum/ thugs yang dag don dgongs pa ru lu 'bru brgyad/ yaun tan che mchog he ru ka'i dgongs pa bdud rtsi rnam bzhi/ phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa phur bu thal 'byin/ rbod gtong ma mo bdun khyab kyi dgongs pa rtsa rlung thig le/ rig 'dzin bla ma byin rlabs kyi dgongs pa thugs gsal rnam dag mchod bstod dregs pa kun 'dus kyi dgongs pa sgrub lugs don bzhi/ drag sngags dug lnga rang mdangs pas gnad kyi man ngag bzhi ste/ de ltar dgu la/ rgyud ma hā yo ga ltar bskyed rim du bsgrub pa/ lung a nu yo ga ltar rdzogs rim sgrubs pa/ man ngag la a ti yo ga ltar rdzogs pa chen por sgrub pa dang yod do/

gdab las kyi rdzong 'phrang srog gsum ni/ bsgral las byed pa'i po dang*/ sgrol byed kyi phur bu/ bsgral bya'i dmigs yul gsum po gzhi chos nyid skye med kyi ngo bor thag chod pa ni lta ba'i rdzong*/ lam rol pa 'gags med gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa ni sgom pa'i 'phrang*/ tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas nus pa bskyed cing dmigs bya bsgral 'dren 195) byas nas 'bras bu zas par skyol ba ni spyod pa'i srog ste/ de nas 'di dag gi don mi shes par sngags 'chang du mi rung ba yang phyi rabs rnams kyi thugs la bcags 'tshal lo/ shu bhaṃ/ maṅga laṃ/ 196)
